subtitle: Your company settings in ERP
readOnly: Your role can only read company settings: the fields are locked.

notSet.title: Your company has not been created in ERP yet
notSet.text: Settings appear once the company is created in the first-run wizard. If you have already created it, check again.

logo.unavailable: The logo is uploaded but the browser cannot show it
logo.hint: PNG, JPEG, WebP or SVG up to 2 MB.

consequence.card: The logo disappears from the company card in ERP.
consequence.file: The file is deleted from ERP storage and cannot be restored.

errors.DEFAULT: The action failed. Try again later.
errors.FORBIDDEN: This section or action is not allowed for your role.
errors.ERP_FORBIDDEN: ERP did not allow this action: it is available to the platform administrator or an employee with company settings rights in ERP.
errors.MARGIN_FORBIDDEN: Margin fields are changed by roles that may see cost and margin.
errors.COMPANY_NOT_SET: Your company has not been created in ERP yet.
errors.CONFLICT: The object has changed or is in use. Refresh the page and try again.
errors.BACKEND_UNAVAILABLE: ERP is not responding. Try again later.

missingBlocks.title: Missing blocks:
missingBlocks.hint: Insert them into the template text or clear "Template is active": a draft saves without the blocks.

reason.lookup_in_use: The row is used in documents and data. Disable it instead of deleting.
reason.category_has_children: The category has subcategories. Move or delete them first.
reason.template_in_use: Documents were already issued from this template. Disable it instead of deleting.
reason.template_missing_required_blocks: The text is missing required document blocks.
reason.doc_prefix_taken: This numbering prefix is already taken by another company. Choose another one.
reason.already_reviewed: The request has already been reviewed. Refresh the list.
reason.invalid_numbering_pattern: The mask has no required {seq} token.
reason.file_too_large: The file is larger than 2 MB.
reason.unsupported_type: A PNG, JPEG, WebP or SVG file is required.
reason.field_not_in_reference: This reference list has no such field.

details.title: Company details
details.hint: Your company's legal data. It goes onto the letterhead wherever “Take details from the company card” is on.
details.name: Full name

consequence.erp: The details are updated in your company card in ERP.
consequence.brand: Letterheads with “Take details from the company card” on will use the new values.

brand.title: Document letterhead and brand
brand.hint: How the company's quote, contract, invoice, act and letter look. The sample on the right follows your edits before you save.

flags.use_company_defaults: Take details from the company card

brand.inheritedTitle: From the company card the document will print:

consequence.documents: New quotes, contracts, invoices and acts are issued on this letterhead.
consequence.preview: The sample on the right shows unsaved edits; saving does not change it.

brand.previewHint: The data in the sample is fictional.

numbering.title: Document numbering
numbering.hint: Format and prefix of your company's quote, contract, invoice, act and letter numbers.
numbering.prefixHint: Up to 16 characters: letters, digits, “-” and “_”.
numbering.prefixTaken: The prefix is taken by another company
numbering.prefixlessBanner: Your own scheme works only with a prefix. The platform format applies now — set a prefix.
numbering.labelsHint: What is put into {type} for each document type.

consequence.issued: Numbers already issued do not change.
consequence.noPrefix: Without a prefix the platform format applies.

numbering.previewHint: ERP calculates the sample from the draft scheme; counters do not change.

quote.title: Default quote terms
quote.hint: What goes into a new quote and calculation: currency, delivery basis, VAT, term, warranty.
quote.marginHidden: Margin fields are hidden: roles with cost and margin rights see them.
quote.thresholdHint: Completeness from which a card may be published (1–100).

consequence.new: New quotes and calculations take these values by default.
consequence.issued: Quotes already issued do not change.

charges.title: Quote charge items
charges.hint: Amounts and rates per delivery basis that go into a calculation: freight, insurance, customs.
charges.rateHint: If set, calculated from the calculation total

consequence.delete: The item disappears from calculation templates for this basis.
consequence.issued: Quotes and calculations already issued do not change.

empty.title: No charge items yet
empty.text: Add amounts and rates per delivery basis — they go into the request calculation.

templates.title: Document and email templates
templates.hint: Contract, act and email texts. Platform samples are not edited — copy them to your company.

documents.name: Name
documents.bodyHint: {{example}} placeholders are replaced with document data.
documents.unknownTitle: Not in the list — they appear in the document as is
documents.copyHint: The copy becomes your template and can be edited. The platform sample does not change.

consequence.delete: The template disappears from the choice list when issuing documents.
consequence.inUse: If documents were already issued from it, ERP refuses — disable the template instead.

empty.title: No document templates yet
empty.text: Create a contract or act template or copy a platform sample.

emails.subject: Subject
emails.activeWarning: An active template immediately replaces the file one for all platform recipients.
emails.previewHint: Nothing is sent; the sample is built on test data from the saved template.
emails.previewAfterSave: The sample is available after the template is saved.

consequence.delete: Emails of this kind return to the platform file template.
consequence.file: Emails already sent do not change.

empty.title: No email templates yet
empty.text: For now emails use the platform file templates. Create your own template to replace the text.

reference.title: ERP reference lists
reference.hint: Countries, currencies, units and delivery bases. A row that documents already use is disabled, not deleted.
reference.noApi: Exchange rates, customs (HS) codes and manufacturers are still kept in the ERP panel: they have no API for the Platform yet.
reference.name: Name

consequence.delete: The row disappears from choice lists.
consequence.disable: If documents already use the row, ERP refuses — disable it instead.

empty.title: No rows yet
empty.text: Add the first row of the list.

categories.title: Catalogue categories and requests for them
categories.hint: The catalogue category tree. Employees request a new category; the platform administrator decides.
categories.name: Name

consequence.delete: The category disappears from the catalogue.
consequence.children: ERP will not delete a category with subcategories — move or delete them first.

empty.title: No categories yet
empty.text: Create the top level of the tree — subcategories are added inside it.

requests.name: Requested category
requests.author: Author
requests.pick: The category you created for the request
requests.pickHint: Approval does not create a category: add it in the Categories part first.
requests.reasonRequired: The reason is required: a refusal without grounds cannot be reviewed.

approve.status: The request becomes Approved with a link to the chosen category.
approve.notify: The author of the request is notified.
approve.create: This action does not create the category itself.

reject.status: The request becomes Rejected with your reason.
reject.notify: The author of the request is notified with the reason.

empty.title: No category requests
empty.text: When an employee asks for a new category, the request appears here.

platform.title: Platform settings
platform.hint: ERP-wide settings for the whole platform: the VAT rate and the exchange rate.
platform.invalidVat: The rate is a number from 0 to 100
platform.rateHint: The rate is kept by ERP and is read-only here.

consequence.new: New calculations and documents use this rate.
consequence.admin: The platform administrator changes the rate; ERP refuses other roles.
